items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I've been close friends to everybody from the singers like Virginia Rustian and on down.

ctx.x: In looking back over your career, all the people you've known and played with, you know, what are some of the things that stand out in your mind, some of the people you've known?

Well, being like I am, I'm always -- I'm a guy that thinks a lot and reminisce a lot -- the whole, everybody, I mean, I could -- I mean, it's been just like I have a million friends, and they're all scattered every place, all in really music business, and I've been close friends to everybody from the singers like Virginia Rustian and on down. I mean anybody you name, it seems funny, and it seems funny for a person to say that they've been contacted with most everybody, but I have. I've played with and worked and…
